1. NFC Tag Placement on Filter:
• Most models (2S, 3, 3H, 4, 4 Pro, Pro H, MAX): The RFID chip is located at the CIRCULAR BOTTOM BASE of the filter.
• Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier ELITE: The chip is placed on the TOP PLASTIC RIM (underneath the replacement reminder text).

2. How to scan with phone:
• Enable NFC in your phone Settings.
• Hold the upper back of your phone directly against the tag location.
• Hold steady for 1-2 seconds until phone vibrates with confirmation.

Xiaomi air purifiers track filter runtime by writing elapsed operational seconds/hours to Block 08 of an NTAG RFID chip. When the threshold is reached, the machine locks out the filter and warns 0% even if the filter element is clean.\n\nThe tag is protected by NTAG password authentication (PWD_AUTH command 0x1B). By taking the SHA-1 hash of the 7-byte UID, we calculate the exact 4-byte password. This tool authenticates with the chip and writes 00000000 to Block 08, restoring filter life back to 100%!
